title: Team logins no longer see links that work without a login
text: Some links we send in the portal chat open a page without any login: the member information form, the add-a-contact form, operating-agreement and SS-4 signing pages, leases and offers. A team login (a colleague an owner added) could read such a link in the company chat or on a flow page and use it for things its owner never gave it: signing, or changing the owners. A team login now sees a short line instead: "A secure link was sent to the company's owner. It is not shown here." Owners, members and TD staff see the links exactly as before, and nothing else about the chat changes. It covers older messages too, and any new kind of link we add later.
